name: SPI_UsrWaitTransferComplete
note: send 1 byte on SPI2, return rx byte

name: get_board_version
note: returns byte at RAM 0x200000d8; AD9363 path needs {2,4,5,6,7}

name: board_version
note: 0 under emulation (no straps); set to 2 for P01007.06

name: spi_fpga_raw_write
note: SPI2 [0x0E, reg, val] -> FPGA reg write

name: init_fpga_config
note: FPGA tables (0x8016260/0x8016460) + AD9363 base profile; no args

name: fpga_reg0_toggle
note: FPGA reg0 |=9 then &=0xfe (heuristic start; tail of pool before init_fpga_config)

name: tcx_config_update1
note: per-channel AD9363 re-tune; guards: [0x20001ab4+0x119]!=0, chan changed, FPGA reg0xE9 bit1

name: fpga_cfg_load
note: writes FPGA regs 0x97-0x9b, 0x04-0x07 from two 5/4-byte structs

name: radio_config_apply
note: board-version gated; FPGA regs 0xb8/0xb9..; called from 0x08010092

name: tcx_tune_caller
note: only caller of tcx_config_update1; no direct BL caller (table/task)

name: tcx_config_power_zone
note: AD9363 TX attenuation / power zone writes

name: radio_start_stop
note: r0=1 start / 0=stop; guarded by [0x20001ab4+0x11a]==0; does FPGA cfg only (NOT AD9363)

name: radio_state
note: struct base; +0x119 active, +0x11a started, +0x11b last channel

name: cmd_exec_set09_cmd06
note: DUML set 0x09 cmd 0x06: single AD9363 reg access (debug)

name: fpga_cfg_table_a
note: boards 2,4,5; 2x256 bytes written to FPGA regs 0..0xff
